Skin, Laser & Hair Reduction

Laser & Skin Aesthetics in Bangalore

Diagnosis-led skin and laser care in Whitefield, Bangalore. Treatment is chosen for your skin type, concern and history after an examination, not the other way round.

Call the Clinic

Diagnosis Before Device

Acne, scars, pigmentation and unwanted hair can look alike and have different causes. At NeoSculpt6, Dr Sandeep Mahapatra examines your skin, asks about your history and previous treatment, and identifies the concern before recommending a laser, peel or other treatment.

Skin type affects which treatments are suitable and how the skin may respond. Your consultation explains the options, likely aftercare and limits, and where a patch test is clinically appropriate it is done first.

  • 01

    Diagnosis first

    The type and cause of your concern are identified before any treatment is chosen.

  • 02

    Skin type

    Your skin type and pigment tendency guide the device, settings and aftercare.

  • 03

    History

    Previous treatments, medicines, sun exposure and how your skin has healed before.

  • 04

    Suitability

    Where a treatment is not right for your skin or not yet, you are told why.

  • 05

    Review

    Response is reviewed between sessions, and the plan changes if it needs to.

Your Skin Assessment

From Examination to Review

Your concern, previous treatments, medicines, sun exposure and how your skin has healed before.

A close look at your skin, with magnification or imaging where useful.

What the concern is and what is causing it, which decides the options.

A test area first when your skin type or the treatment calls for it.

The suitable treatment, settings and timing, and what it can and cannot change.

Sun protection, skincare and what to expect in the days after treatment.

Your response is checked before any further session; results vary from person to person.

    Quick Answers

    Laser & Skin FAQs

    Many skin concerns look alike but have different causes. The doctor diagnoses the concern and checks your skin type and history first, because they decide which treatment is suitable and how your skin may respond.

    Many treatments can be adapted to different skin types, but settings, timing and aftercare differ. Your doctor explains what suits your skin and whether a patch test is needed first.

    It depends on the concern, your skin and how it responds, so the number is not fixed in advance. Your response is reviewed between sessions.

    Some treatments cause temporary redness, peeling or darkening, and stronger treatments need more recovery. Your doctor explains what to expect for your plan, along with aftercare.

    A mole or lesion is examined first. Some need further assessment before any removal, and the doctor explains the right next step.

    Cost depends on your assessment, the treatment, the area, the number of sessions and aftercare, so it is explained after your consultation rather than quoted in advance.
